highlights: Earn 10 DBS Points for every S$5 spent on eligible online categories such as local spending, overseas spending, online shopping, dining, groceries, taxi rides, hotel bookings, flight bookings, and online food delivery. For non-online overseas transactions, you’ll earn 1.2 miles per dollar (or 3 DBS Points). For general spending, earn 1 DBS Point per S$5. Note that rewards are capped at S$1,500 per calendar month.
pros: 10X DBS points (20 miles) for every S$5 spent on online purchases.
pros: 3X DBS points (6 miles) for every S$5 spent on overseas purchases.
pros: 1X DBS points (2 miles) for every S$5 spent on other purchases.
pros: Complimentary e-commerce protection for online purchases.
pros: Enjoy special promotions and discounts for certain fashion, beauty and wellness stores.
pros: Both women and men can apply.
cons: DBS points are only awarded for every S$5 spent.
cons: 10X DBS points are only applicable for the first S$1,500 online spend per calendar month.
cons: Minimum income requirement for Singaporeans/PRs: S$80,000.
cons: Minimum income requirement for foreigners: S$80,000.

extra.description: Bring out your inner shopaholic as you earn an equivalent of 4mpd on online spend with the DBS Woman's World Card, while enjoying exclusive card privileges in shopping, dining, and travel, all year round.
